{{Quote|They crashed into Doshar Field.|[[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]] reports to [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]]|audio=DosharFields-TGG.flac|<ref name="The Gungan General" />}}
'''Doshar fields''', also known as simply '''Doshar Field''', were desert fields on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], filled with acid [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]]. They were inhabited by [[Skalder/Legends|skalders]], whose thick hides protected them from the caustic environment.<ref name="The Gungan General" />
